name: Lunar Polar Ice Excavation Fidelity v1
description: The surrogate-fidelity task: a single excavator digs icy regolith on the anchor's Shackleton-de Gerlache ridge for 10 s of contact-scale time, and the benchmark measures what the high-fidelity DEM granular solver costs against a learned surrogate standing in for it - at the error bound the substitution actually held to (surrogate.md §8/§12; RM-P1-SURR-04 / RM-P1-SIM-03; LUNAR-TR-002). THIS SCENARIO'S HEADLINE RESULT IS THE SPEEDUP, NOT THE SCORECARD: see RESULTS.md and PROVENANCE.md. Content is REUSED by hash from the anchor's published Hub artifacts, except the excavator, which is pinned at 0.2.0 - the first revision to declare its digging blade as a SADF `tool` contact element, which is what routes it to the granular contact ladder at all (astro-mine-fleet#37). The episode's declared cadence (10.0 s / 200 steps = 0.05 s) is the contact-scale tick the granular tiers integrate at, so the task's cadence and the runner's agree rather than the runner silently overriding the task. This scenario does not exercise the operational_targeting dual-use gate.

world.description: Shackleton-de Gerlache ridge, lunar south pole, version 0.4.0. It supplies the terramechanics the granular tiers are parameterized by - regolith bulk density 1500 kg/m3 and friction angle 40 deg, i.e. a friction COEFFICIENT of tan(40 deg) = 0.839, which is the number the surrogate's trust region has to cover. 0.4.0 is the first anchor world to ship its horizon map (illumination/horizon.zarr), so it resolves in ~3 s instead of re-deriving a 192-million-entry skyline from the packaged DEM on every load (astro-mine-worlds#46). Its regolith rasters - the only thing this task reads from it - are byte-identical to the bundle the anchor pinned before. See PROVENANCE.md.

fleet.description: Granular excavation (bucket/auger), version 0.2.0 - the first excavator to declare a `tool` contact element. Its blade's cutting width (0.40 m) and height (0.15 m) size the DEM particle bed and tool. Real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.

prospect.description: Water-ice belief prior over the default Shackleton grid; the sealed GroundTruthField is realized per seed at runtime. Reused from the anchor's real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.
